key_idea: Bits are independent: at position T+1 every edge with t>T forces equality and every edge with t=T forces difference, so each level is a 2-colouring of the T-edges on the DSU of heavier edges, and the cheaper colour class gets the 1.
sketch: Sort prophecies by t descending and process groups of equal t. For a group, map endpoints to DSU roots (components of all edges with larger t); an edge inside one root is a contradiction; otherwise 2-colour the graph on roots by DFS (odd cycle means impossible) and for each connected piece add min(total caravans on side 0, side 1) using DSU sizes; then union the group. Positions not equal to some t+1 are all cliffside for free. O(m log m). Pitfalls: answer needs 64-bit, weights are component sizes not root counts, clear the per-level adjacency only for touched roots, and merge only after the whole level is coloured. Stress-tested against brute force over all bit strings for n<=5.
